name: The Antlers on Grandview
address: 10 Grandview Ave, Green Mountain Falls, CO 80819
short_description: Rustic 5-bedroom log cabin with vaulted ceilings, wood-burning fireplace, and charming claw-foot tub.
full_description:
The Antlers Cabin is rustic log cabin retreat loaded with charm and updated with many modern amenities. It is located in Green Mountain Falls, a quaint vacation town at the foot of Pikes Peak, close to Colorado Springs – but snuggled in the mountains for that true mountain town feel.

This historic log cabin includes three levels of living space with 5 bedrooms, 2 full baths and one half bath.

The ground floor has 2 bedrooms, one with a full size bed and one with a queen size bed, a full bathroom with tub/shower combo and family-play room. On the main floor, the wood-burning fireplace takes center stage in the great room, which is complete with vaulted ceiling, hardwood floors and real log walls. The dining room table seats 8 with 2 benches and 2 chairs. The adjacent sun room is a cozy place to read or play games. The master bedroom with queen size bed adjoins the nostalgic bathroom with charming claw-foot tub. The kitchen boasts a stove, full-size refrigerator, dishwasher and a breakfast area with table and chairs.

The top floor includes 2 additional bedrooms and a half bath. These two bedrooms each have a built-in full size bed along with a single bed.

Off the kitchen is a nice patio area for grilling and dining. An additional patio on the opposite side of the house and an enclosed deck off of the sun room provide ample opportunities to enjoy the beautiful mountain views.

Green Mountain Falls is a quiet little town with shops, restaurants, a fishing pond, hiking trails, public swimming pool, tennis courts, creeks and its namesake waterfalls. Nestled in a small valley, the central business district rings a small lake with a picturesque gazebo in the middle.

This cabin makes a great home base for trips to many major tourist attractions including: The Garden of the Gods, Pikes Peak, The U.S. Air Force Academy, Cave of the Winds, Seven Falls, the U.S. Olympic Training Center and many more. Shoppers will love a day trip to Manitou Springs or Old Colorado City. Those who love the outdoors will find great hiking, fishing, golf, 4-wheeling, rafting and biking nearby.
